notes: This portable C++ TCK scenario uses only the official IEEE 1516.1 RTIambassador API, the standard library, and adapter-supplied application FOM, standard MIM, provider package, endpoint, and callback configuration. It sends the standard federate-level HLAsetSwitches interaction with official ResignAction values encoded as HLAinteger32BE, observes each value through getAutomaticResignDirective, and restores the observed starting value before resigning. It does not trigger an automatic-resign action or rely on provider-specific names, registries, headers, or internal switch state.

api_surfaces.signature: RTIambassador standard-MIM interaction and parameter lookup, receive-order sendInteraction, ResignAction query, and federation lifecycle
